design_philosophy: Civic tech must feel trustworthy, grounded, and highly accessible. Avoiding the generic SaaS 'tech-bro' dark mode. Embracing warm, natural tones reflecting rural India but with a premium, modern 'Old Money Tech' structural rigor. Focus is on clear data presentation and a welcoming public-facing interface.

typography.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight text-[#1A1A1A] font-bold
typography.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight text-[#1A1A1A] font-semibold
typography.label: text-sm tracking-[0.05em] uppercase font-semibold text-[#4A4A4A]

layout_and_spacing.generous_spacing: Use p-8 to p-12 for landing page sections. Dashboard should use p-6.
layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy_marketing: Mode A: The 'Tetris' Grid for landing page feature showcases. Mix col-span-4 and col-span-8 for asymmetry. Add generous gap-8.
layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy_dashboard: Mode B: The 'Control Room' Grid. Dense, 1px borders, tight gap-4 or gap-6 for metrics and tables. Optimize for scanability.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: Subtle roundness: rounded-lg (8px) or rounded-xl (12px) max. Avoid heavily rounded pill shapes.

surfaces_and_components.headers: Solid background bg-[#FAFAFA] with a sharp 1px bottom border border-[#DCD7CB]. Do not use glassmorphism.
surfaces_and_components.dashboard_cards: Flat background bg-white, 1px subtle border border-[#DCD7CB], no shadow by default. Hover: slight lift -translate-y-1 and shadow-sm.
surfaces_and_components.buttons: Primary buttons: bg-[#2D4238] text-white hover:bg-[#1E2D26]. Secondary: border border-[#DCD7CB] text-[#1A1A1A]. Use rounded-md.
surfaces_and_components.tables: Use Shadcn Table. Left-align text. Zebra striping or subtle border-b on rows. Action items on the far right.
surfaces_and_components.forms: Use Shadcn Form/Input. Input fields should have bg-white and border-[#DCD7CB]. Focus ring must be ring-[#2D4238].

animation_and_motion.hover_states: All buttons and cards must have transition-transform and transition-colors duration-200.
animation_and_motion.page_transitions: Staggered fade-up for lists (Complaints, Certificates) using Framer Motion.

image_urls.description: Premium wide-angle shot of Gram Panchayat courtyard. Use as the main visual for the landing page.

Portrait for Deputy Sarpanch / Member in the Panchayat Members directory.
Village landscape image. Can be used in the About section or Landing Page overview.

component_instructions.navigation: Sticky top nav. Includes Logo (text), links (Home, Dashboard, Login), primary CTA. Must have a bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md.
component_instructions.sidebar: Fixed sidebar on dashboard. Warm sand background bg-[#F3F1EC]. High contrast text for active state.
component_instructions.complaints_section: List view using Shadcn Table or dense Cards. Status badges: Pending (warning color), In Progress (blue/info), Resolved (success color).
component_instructions.certificates_section: Split view: Form for application, and tracking table below it. Keep form inputs clear and labeled.
component_instructions.bills_section: View-only table. Emphasize read-only amounts and dates clearly.
component_instructions.meetings_section: Timeline or simple list view showing upcoming and past meetings. Highlight dates and agenda.
component_instructions.notices_board: A dedicated card stack or prominent alert banner for urgent village announcements.
component_instructions.admin_dashboard: Focus on tabular data for managing Certificates and Complaints with quick action buttons (Approve/Reject).

testing_attributes.requirement: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
